references.text: Here it is shown that God lets people walk on water, which mirrors the miracle Jesus performs.
This event, where Peter walks on water following Jesus' example, is directly related to Jesus' miracle.
Mark's version of the event, which emphasizes Jesus' divine nature.
Luke does not mention this specific event, but the context around the time period and Jesus' teachings is relevant.
John's account of how the disciples saw Jesus walking on water, which strengthens faith in his supernatural abilities.
